ln:4441926847.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective.
  • Coach teams on Agile/Scrum principles and continuously improve team maturity and delivery effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points and strategic priorities.
  • Conduct analysis and documentation of business requirements, user journeys and system/process impacts.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
  • Partner with Product Owner and delivery teams to prioritize backlog items based on business value and dependencies.
  • Identify delivery risks, impediments and blockers; drive timely resolution and escalation where required.
  • Support UAT planning, test scenario definition and quality assurance alignment with business expectations.
  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time, delivery predictability, quality indicators).
  • Build and maintain strong communication channels across business and technical teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose practical, data-driven improvements.
  • Support change management, user enablement and post-implementation adoption activities.
  • Own end-to-end project management activities including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control and closure.
  • Define and manage project scope, timeline, milestones, resource plan and budget to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
  • Establish and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), governance cadence and escalation framework.
  • Drive cross-team/vendor coordination and dependency management across technology, operations and business units.
  • Prepare management reporting and steering committee updates on project health, delivery progress and decision points.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards, SDLC controls and audit/regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Manage release readiness and implementation planning, including cutover, communication and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Support benefits tracking and realization against approved business case/objectives.

Requirements

  • University degree or above.
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant working experience in technology/digital delivery, including proven experience in Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery roles.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery framework, SDLC and project management methodologies (Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, dependency mapping, financial/budget tracking and resource management.
  • Experience with Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Office, Power BI, MS Project).
  • High customer-centric mindset with commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive outcomes under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance strategic and tactical priorities.
  • Experience in governance reporting, risk/issue management, and senior stakeholder/SteerCo communication.
  • Relevant certification(s) such as CSM/PSM, PMI-ACP, CBAP/CCBA, PMP/PRINCE2 would be an advantage.

/NA

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

ln:4441933777.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of the Hong Kong customer system transformation to CDMS.
  • Analyse existing customer system flows across online and batch processes to identify common capabilities, market-specific journeys, and opportunities for simplification.
  • Design, implement, and support technical solutions for customer data management in the Hong Kong market.
  • Ensure technology solutions align with business priorities, customer outcomes, and broader transformation goals.
  • Drive both Run-the-Bank and Change-the-Bank requirements in line with strategic objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership across development, testing, migration, and production implementation activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions.

Data Management & Governance

  • Support the implementation of data governance standards, controls, and best practices.
  • Ensure high standards of data quality, integrity, security, and consistency across customer data platforms.
  • Translate business data requirements into effective technical solutions.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

  • Partner with business, operations, architecture, and engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical and data concepts clearly to a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Work effectively across global and distributed teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment.

Delivery Excellence

  • Apply Agile delivery practices, including Scrum and SAFe, to manage priorities and execution.
  • Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity across coding, testing, and migration.
  • Manage multiple workstreams effectively while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience leading software development and technical delivery in large-scale banking environments.
  • Deep understanding of customer systems in Hong Kong
  • Solid experience with legacy/mainframe technologies, including:
  • MVS/z/Series/CICS/JCL/DB2/PROC
  • Knowledge of modern integration technologies, including:
  • APIs/Spring Boot/NoSQL databases such as MongoDB
  • Experience with AI tools and automation for software engineering, testing, and migration activities.

Functional & Domain Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of customer data domains, customer lifecycle processes, and front-line customer-facing platforms.
  • Experience delivering large-scale, complex transformation programmes in banking or financial services.
  • Good understanding of the regulatory environment in financial services, particularly data-related controls and compliance considerations.
  • Knowledge of enterprise operating models, governance, and change delivery within large organisations.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Proven leadership experience in driving teams through large-scale technology and cultural change.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across business and technology functions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.

/NA

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

ln:4455594391.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
  • 扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
  • 根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
  • 向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
  • 配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
  • 具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
  • 具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
  • 以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
  • 了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
  • 成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
  • 具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
  • 普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4453106378.descriptionHtml:
Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
  • Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

    • At least 8 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
    • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
    • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
    • Strong focus on client servicing
    • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
    • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business:CTO

Principal Responsibilities

  • Backend architecture & delivery for RAG (incl. Graph RAG & agentic search): Design and implement core RAG backend capabilities, including retrieval, re-ranking, context construction, prompt orchestration, response aggregation, Graph RAG patterns (entity/relation extraction, graph traversal, graph-grounded context assembly), and agentic search (multi-step query planning, iterative retrieval, tool/function calling).
  • Build pipelines for multi-modal and multi-type data (documents, emails, wikis, images, tables, logs, structured sources), including extraction/OCR, chunking, enrichment, embedding, and incremental re-indexing with rollback.
  • Retrieval, ranking & graph reasoning optimisation: Implement hybrid retrieval (BM25/vector/structured filters), multi-stage recall, reranking (cross-encoder/LLM), deduplication/diversity controls, and graph-based retrieval strategies to improve relevance, explainability, and traceability.
  • Grounded, supported answer generation: Build generation workflows that produce grounded answers with explicit support (citations, quoted evidence snippets, and source metadata), including answer structuring, confidence/scoring signals, refusal/insufficient-evidence handling, and traceable “why this answer” outputs for auditability.
  • Security & compliance: Implement access controls (RBAC/ABAC), data classification and masking, audit logging, encryption, and secrets management; ensure retrieval and generation flows meet bank-grade compliance requirements.
  • Data governance & lineage: Enforce data ownership, classification, retention, and access policies; maintain metadata standards, lineage, and provenance (citations/attribution) to ensure outputs are grounded in approved sources.
  • Quality evaluation & continuous improvement: Establish offline/online evaluation (groundedness, faithfulness, citation coverage, latency), enabling A/B testing and regression validation.
  • Cross-team collaboration: Partner with AI Infra, data platforms, information security, and product teams to land RAG capabilities in multiple systems and continuously evolve the platform.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience; strong proficiency in at least one mainstream backend stack: Python (FastAPI) or Go.
  • Solid understanding of core RAG components and patterns, including chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, context window management, citations/attribution, and evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience with containerisation and cloud-native engineering (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), with a proven track record of troubleshooting and performance tuning in production.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to deliver under multi-dimensional constraints (security, compliance, performance, and cost).
  • Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Product Development .

Business: Chief AI Office

Job ID ： 63096

Principal Responsibilities

  • Reporting & stakeholders: The role reports to the Pod Lead (PO) or Product Manager (as defined by the pod operating model). The UI/UX Designer works day-to-day with Business Analysts, engineers (AI/ML Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and front-end/full-stack engineers), the QA/Testing Lead and the Tech Delivery Lead to ensure designs are buildable, testable and delivered to schedule. They partner closely with Change & Adoption Lead to support adoption through intuitive journeys and, where needed, in-product guidance. The role also collaborates with the AI Solution Architect, data/platform teams and the Responsible AI Practitioner to ensure AI-enabled experiences are transparent, safe and aligned to Group AI standards. Where required, they engage in Risk, Compliance, Legal, Privacy and Information Security to ensure that experience design supports approvals, required disclosures and evidence expectations in a regulated environment.
  • Scope & authority: The UI/UX Designer owns the end-to-end experience design for the pod’s AI-enabled features, from journey mapping and interaction design through to UI pattern definition, prototyping and usability validation. They are accountable for producing clear, build-ready design outputs - clickable prototypes, annotated user flows, content guidance and detailed design specifications (components, states, accessibility notes and error handling) - so delivery teams can implement with pace and minimal rework. They have the authority to propose and recommend experience options and trade-offs, grounded in user evidence and delivery constraints, including decisions around automation vs human oversight, transparency vs friction and handling of AI uncertainty and failure modes. Final decisions on product scope, investment and priority remain with the Pod Lead, but the UI/UX Designer is accountable for ensuring experience risks are surfaced early, addressed through design, and aligned to design system standards, Responsible AI expectations and required governance/approvals. The role does not own product prioritisation or backlog decisions; it influences these through tested prototypes, user evidence and clear experience trade-offs

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • This role exists to ensure AI-enabled solutions are designed around real user needs, are easy to use, and build trust - reducing rework and driving adoption. The UI/UX Designer brings clarity to complex AI behaviours through strong interaction design, validated journeys and production-ready specs.
  • Target journey & product definition - Partner with Pod Lead/PO, BA and business stakeholders to define the target user journeys and key moments that AI will improve. Translate AI capabilities/constraints (confidence, latency, failure modes, monitoring) into clear experience patterns and user expectations. Ensure the experience supports end-to-end outcomes, not isolated screens (e.g., request → decision/support → follow-up → audit trail).
  • UX discovery, research & testing standards - Plan and run lightweight discovery: stakeholder interviews, contextual enquiry, workflow walkthroughs and heuristic reviews. Define hypotheses and success measures for experience quality (task success, time-on-task, error rate, comprehension of AI outputs). Run rapid, repeatable usability testing on prototypes and early builds to validate journeys and UI patterns, synthesise findings, and drive iterative design improvements.
  • UI patterns, prototyping & design specification - Create wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for key flows, edge cases and system states (loading, low confidence, refusal, escalation). Provide build-ready design specifications covering components, states, empty/error cases, accessibility notes, responsive behaviour and content guidance to support build and QA. Promote reuse by applying approved design systems and reusable components/patterns; propose new components only when justified and document rationale for reuse.
  • Design alignment to Responsible AI and control expectations - Embed “trust cues” and transparency: what the AI did, why, confidence/limits, and what users should do next. Design for safe use: appropriate human oversight, escalation paths, confirmation steps, and prevention of harmful/incorrect actions. Partner with Responsible AI Practitioner and control functions to ensure design supports required evidence and approvals (e.g., disclosures, decision records, audit trail touchpoints).
  • Delivery collaboration & quality in execution - Work closely with engineers and QA to ensure designs are implemented as intended; join backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies as needed. Support design QA: verify UI implementation, interaction fidelity, accessibility compliance and content accuracy. Keep design artefacts current (journey maps, prototypes, specs) so decisions remain traceable and delivery stays unblocked.
  • Adoption and change support (experience-led) - Partner with Change & Adoption Lead to ensure the solution is intuitive, learnable and supported by in-product guidance where needed. Identify friction points likely to reduce adoption and recommend design changes, onboarding or comms mitigations.

/WX

Ensure the experience supports end-to-end outcomes, not isolated screens (e.g., request → decision/support → follow-up → audit trail).
- UX discovery, research & testing standards - Plan and run lightweight discovery: stakeholder interviews, contextual enquiry, workflow walkthroughs and heuristic reviews. Define hypotheses and success measures for experience quality (task success, time-on-task, error rate, comprehension of AI outputs). Run rapid, repeatable usability testing on prototypes and early builds to validate journeys and UI patterns, synthesise findings, and drive iterative design improvements.
- UI patterns, prototyping & design specification - Create wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes for key flows, edge cases and system states (loading, low confidence, refusal, escalation). Provide build-ready design specifications covering components, states, empty/error cases, accessibility notes, responsive behaviour and content guidance to support build and QA. Promote reuse by applying approved design systems and reusable components/patterns; propose new components only when justified and document rationale for reuse.
- Design alignment to Responsible AI and control expectations - Embed “trust cues” and transparency: what the AI did, why, confidence/limits, and what users should do next. Design for safe use: appropriate human oversight, escalation paths, confirmation steps, and prevention of harmful/incorrect actions. Partner with Responsible AI Practitioner and control functions to ensure design supports required evidence and approvals (e.g., disclosures, decision records, audit trail touchpoints).
- Delivery collaboration & quality in execution - Work closely with engineers and QA to ensure designs are implemented as intended; join backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies as needed. Support design QA: verify UI implementation, interaction fidelity, accessibility compliance and content accuracy. Keep design artefacts current (journey maps, prototypes, specs) so decisions remain traceable and delivery stays unblocked.
- Adoption and change support (experience-led) - Partner with Change & Adoption Lead to ensure the solution is intuitive, learnable and supported by in-product guidance where needed. Identify friction points likely to reduce adoption and recommend design changes, onboarding or comms mitigations.
